prompt_en: An editorial lifestyle photograph of one unmistakably adult woman in a compact apartment living room that looks neat yet actively used. Her visible appearance takes loose guidance from the supplied portrait: long dark softly waved hair parted near the center and a calm face. She is midway through returning a closed blue paperback to the narrow gap between upright books on an oak shelf. Her left palm supports the lower edge of the book while her right fingertips steady its upper edge; the book is halfway inserted, its fore-edge entering the gap and its spine still projecting from the row. She stands on both feet close to the shelf with her elbows naturally bent, and the open shelf faces the camera. A glass of water sits on a side table beside a pale sofa with slightly compressed cushions; a pleated lamp stands on a sideboard, and a small plant brightens the window sill. Clear overcast daylight reveals the lived-in order, her touching hands, the half-returned book, and its exact target gap in one medium-wide frame. At this instant, a person returns one used item to its place in a clean room: the same blue paperback enters its established gap while her fingers still touch it. Behind the gesture, one recently cleared work surface remains visible as the broad sideboard top with a faint rectangular patch where the paperback rested. Near it, one small remaining task stays active beside the cleared area: a half-folded throw waits across the nearby sofa arm. Across the lower frame, an open walking path connects the active area to the room as uninterrupted wood floor between the bookcase and sofa. Use a horizontal three-to-two full-room frame from a room-facing three-quarter angle that shows her whole figure, both shoes on the floor, the book’s exposed blue cover and entering edge, and a visible receiving gap between upright books. Keep the hands, a loose fold of the sofa throw, the sideboard’s rectangular cleared patch, and a continuous floor path in view. Broad overcast light reveals the book edge and sideboard patch.
